segments.title: WhatsApp is building full-quality photos
segments.say: WhatsApp is building zero-compression photos. But it's planned for paid WhatsApp Plus users.

segments.title: Even HD still squeezes photos
segments.say: Today, even HD still compresses your photos a bit.

segments.title: Free fix: send as a document
segments.say: The free fix works now. Tap attach, choose Document, pick your photo. It arrives uncompressed.

segments.title: Or make HD your default
segments.say: Or make HD your default in Settings, Storage and data, Media upload quality.
